preconditions.expression: isinstance(times, list) and all(isinstance(t, str) for t in times)
preconditions.description: times is a list of strings

preconditions.expression: all(len(t) == 5 and t[2] == ':' and t[:2].isdigit() and t[3:].isdigit() for t in times)
preconditions.description: each time string is in the format 'HH:MM' with valid hour and minute digits

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(t[:2]) < 24 and 0 <= int(t[3:]) < 60 for t in times)
preconditions.description: each time string represents a valid 24-hour time

postconditions.expression: isinstance(return_value, str) and len(return_value) == 5 and return_value[2] == ':' and return_value[:2].isdigit() and return_value[3:].isdigit()
postconditions.description: the return value is a string in the format 'HH:MM'
the return value represents a valid 24-hour time
the return value is the maximum time interval between alarms
